heading: Affordable Housing
text: Vicki believes that everyone should have the opportunity to own a home. She is ready to fight for affordability in Orange County and help homeowners keep their homes.

heading: Infrastructure
text: Orange County needs to invest in local infrastructure today in order to meet the needs of tomorrow. This includes improving our roads, sidewalks, stormwater drainage, and local parks.

heading: Green Spaces
text: Orange County’s parks bring our community together. They also help shape the future of our community. Vicki is committed to increasing youth recreation to ensure Orange County has an even brighter future.

heading: County Services
text: From upgrading public transportation to increasing accessible healthcare, Vicki Vargo is ready to fight for us. Why? Because Orange County deserves quality county services!
